title: Hellraiser: Revival Skull Puzzle & Tongue Key
description: Find the Tongue Key in Bruno’s office, compare conflicting skull-pin directions, and use the mouth door. Spoiler-controlled steps and a short video reference.
body:
A fleshy mouth blocks the exit from Bruno’s office. The Tongue Key comes from the pinned skull on his desk, not from a numeric cabinet. Start here if those are the objects in front of you.

Identify the right object

Thumb Wars identifies two skulls on the desk and directs players to the one on the right. Inspect the pinned skull, rotate it to see the back and crown, and leave the mouth door for after the key is collected.

1. Hint: inspect before pressing

The pins are interactive. Keep a consistent viewing direction while comparing a written sequence with the skull.

2. Published sequences and their limits

For a defined starting view, PowerPyx instructs you to turn the skull so its face points away from you, then press left → back → right → top. Follow that viewing instruction with the sequence; do not combine it with another guide’s left/right labels.

Thumb Wars lists left → back → right → top; NoobFeed lists right → upper back → left → top center. GameTrek only says to press every pin. The descriptions do not establish the same viewing orientation. We cannot confirm whether the difference is perspective, a guide error or game behavior.

3. Collect the key and open the door

After the skull opens, collect the Tongue Key from its mouth. Return to the nearby mouth door and use that key. An open skull alone does not mean the key is already in your inventory.

If the sequence resets

Stop and compare the physical pins rather than alternating contradictory left/right instructions. The linked short clip is a visual reference for the key task; we have not verified it as a complete orientation tutorial. If the door still rejects the key, check the inventory first.

title: Hellraiser: Revival Endings — Accept or Decline?
description: Spoiler-controlled Hellraiser: Revival ending choices, Experience Beyond Limits and Human After All, plus the reported PS5 final-autosave replay route.
body:
At the final choice, “good” and “bad” can be misleading labels. This guide uses the actions that distinguish the two ending trophies; open the details only when you are ready for the final scene.

Before you make the choice

Retain your final save. PowerPyx’s PS5 launch guide reports that the final autosave can be reloaded to choose the other ending in one playthrough. Check that the save is present before relying on that route.

Reveal the two choices and trophy names

Accept the Cenobites’ offer by following them through the opening: Experience Beyond Limits. Decline by staying in the apartment until the opening closes: Human After All.

Save availability depends on difficulty and build. Do not assume that an autosave exists on Hard or Hellraiser; verify the actual save menu before the final decision.

Keep your completion record useful

Record which trophy actually unlocked before reloading. A checklist is only your note; it cannot recreate an overwritten save or prove that the game awarded a trophy.

title: Hellraiser: Revival First Zora Shop — Trophy Bug Report
description: Protect a PS5 trophy run at the first Zora shop. Dated buying/selling tracker report, manual-save precautions and the source’s workaround, without patch guarantees.
body:
If you are planning PS5 trophies, pause at the first Zora shop. PowerPyx reports that the launch trackers for What’re Ya Buyin? and What’re Ya Sellin? can stop after that shop. This is a dated report, not proof that every current platform or patch has the bug.

Protect the run first

Make a manual save at the save point beside the shop before selling equipment. Keep it until you have checked the trophy result. Do not sacrifice your usable inventory merely to test a report.

Show the reported targets and workaround

The reported targets are 666+ coins spent and 999+ earned from sales. PowerPyx suggests buying and selling at the first shop, then reloading the pre-shop save and repeating if necessary. This is a reported workaround; success is not guaranteed.

If you already passed the shop

Check whether you still have an earlier save. Record your platform, build and the tracker’s observed behavior before reporting a problem. We have not verified an official fix or a recovery method for a run with no suitable save.
